programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Airport Opening: Adventure Bay is getting a brand new airport, and today's the grand opening! A jealous Sweetie sabotages the Royal Plane so she can take the Princess' place. (S11, ep 6)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig's Pond: Peppa, George are helping Grandpa pig to dig a brand new pond for his garden!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Move To Music: Madame Gazelle is getting Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Market: Peppa and family find some great things to buy from the market and even get a special gift from Mr. Fox's stall.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Long Train Journey: Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Decorating: With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick? (S8, ep 3)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Hobbies: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do. (S8, ep 6)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Run Daddy Run: Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park. (S8, ep 24)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Big Hill: When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Gaston's Birthday: It's King Thistle's birthday, but he does not want a birthday party. But Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, so King Thistle says it can be Gaston's birthday party.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Granny and Granpapa: A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Superheroes: The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her supervillain role a bit too far, it is up to Elf Man and Fairy Girl to save the day!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Elf Rescue: With so many rescue missions, Elf Rescue needs a helping hand from Children Rescue!

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Wingnut's junk pile and Oscar go missing at the same time in 'Pups Stop the Junk-Monster', then in 'Pups Save the Whale Pod', Francois accidentally crashes his diving bell. (S7, ep 25)

programme.title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: TV Land: Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: The Park: Peppa Pig goes to the park to play with friends and have new experiences.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Father Christmas: When Peppa meets Father Christmas at the supermarket, she invites him to her playgroup's Christmas play.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Tractor: Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Big Announcement: Today is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George. However, Peppa and George struggle to wait patiently, so resort to playing games.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Sibling School: While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives. (S8, ep 10)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Undersea Party: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Indoor Adventure: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Woodpecker: King Thistle is bored and takes up the hobby of bird watching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: King Thistle Is Not Well: King Thistle has a cold and needs medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly and Ben have fun collecting the ingredients for a magic potion to make him better.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Seeking a Safer Sodor: When Percy and Kana have a near-collision because they're distracted, they blame insufficient safety measures. (S2, ep 44)

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: A Cranky Goodbye: When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they have to learn how to express their feelings in order to save their sinking friendship. (S2, ep 45)

programme.title: DORA
programme.desc: Dora and Boots help Benny with a new move in 'Volleybull!', then in 'Diferente es Excelente', Dora and Boots show Dulce the dragon that everyone's differences are what make them excellent! (S4, ep 11)

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space
programme.desc: Surf: Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space
programme.desc: Tickets: Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket. (S1, ep 47)

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space
programme.desc: Spaceship: Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programme.desc: Mr Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake in 'Paddington and the Lake Monster', and in 'Paddington's Space Radio', Toq wants to let her dad know she's thinking of him up in space. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Wedding Day: It's the day of Mrs Cow and Mr Bull's wedding! Not everything goes to plan, but that doesn't stop it being the best wedding ever, and there is a lot of happy crying! (S7, ep 16)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Party Bus: Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party - on a double decker bus! (S7, ep 17)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Movie Night: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat. (S7, ep 18)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Art House Day: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork. (S7, ep 19)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Wildflower Wood: Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even an orchid! (S7, ep 20)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Sunny Day Games: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool! (S7, ep 21)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Magic Trick: Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party, and Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works. (S7, ep 22)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Jumping Stick: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles! (S7, ep 23)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Racquet Games: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier. (S7, ep 24)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Adventure Caravan: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day. (S7, ep 25)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Caravan Friends: After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car! Luckily, the bear family stop it just in time. (S7, ep 26)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Chloe's Birthday Party: At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake! (S7, ep 27)

programme.desc: The Queen Bakes Cakes: A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no-one can eat her cakes.

programme.desc: Clouds: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.

programme.desc: Nursery Rhymes: Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their best nursery rhymes with each other. [SL]

programme.desc: Lenses: Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things!

programme.title: Haunted Hospitals
programme.desc: Calls From Beyond, The Grim Reaper and Tag You're Dead: A technician receives terrifying calls from numbers that don't exist, while a nurse battles the Grim Reaper. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas
programme.desc: Hands Off Embroidery: Fort Worth witnesses a showdown when Cowboy Matt begins throwing his weight around. Jenny wins a locker containing a very strange item. (S5, ep 11)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: Join antiques expert and presenter David Dickinson as more collectors try to sell their items to dealers. Will they strike a deal or take a chance at auction instead? (S9, ep 55)

programme.title: Storage Wars
